# Epinoia Horizon

> Epinoia Horizon is a creative research and development collective exploring emerging technology and creative practice.
> The collective brings research, design, and engineering together to explore ideas and develop prototypes, tools, and experiences.

## Project
- [Merlin Agent](https://withmerlin.online/): an AI agent project by Epinoia Horizon; its product home has moved.
- [Merlin documentation](https://withmerlin.online/docs/).
- [Merlin pricing](https://withmerlin.online/pricing/).
- [Merlin releases](https://github.com/epinoiahorizon/Merlin-Agent/releases).
